findings.title: Misspelled config alias "delayed-suthenticator-config" in the test flow setup
findings.description: The `delayed-authenticator` execution in `configureBrowserFlowWithRecoveryAuthnCodes` sets its alias to `"delayed-suthenticator-config"`. The word "authenticator" is misspelled as "suthenticator". The alias is only a label, so the test may still run, but any lookup or assertion that uses the correctly spelled name will fail.

findings.title: `RecoveryAuthnCodesUtils` is called without an import visible in the hunk
findings.description: `RecoveryAuthnCodesFormAuthenticator` now calls `RecoveryAuthnCodesUtils.getCredential(...)`, but the hunk adds no `org.keycloak.models.utils.RecoveryAuthnCodesUtils` import. The import may already exist outside the hunk. I could not check, so this is unverified and would fail to compile if the import is missing.

findings.title: Local-storage branch passes `credentialModel` instead of the JSON-bearing credential
findings.description: In `createRecoveryCodesCredential`, the JSON-serialized `recoveryCodesCredential` is built and used only for `user.credentialManager().updateCredential(...)`. When that returns false, the fallback calls `recoveryCodeCredentialProvider.createCredential(realm, user, credentialModel)`, so the generated codes reach the local store only if `credentialModel` already carries them. That holds if the caller populates it, which I could not verify from the diff.
